description: Details required by Condition 6 (Trees and landscaping) of planning permission 25/05291 (Extension of closet wing across all floors to match rearwards projection of neighbouring properties; lowering of lower ground floor level; erection of a single storey rear extension at lower ground floor level; erection of a rear infill at ground floor level; elevational alterations; replacement of windows with double glazed units; reconfiguration of front entrance steps to create independent access to lower ground floor level; replacement of front railings; internal reconfiguration of two flats and provision of two condenser units within an acoustic enclosure at main roof level. (Works are the same as approved under PP/25/04111 save for the provision of 2no. AC units at main roof level))
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
